item.title: Medical inflation and tax changes are increasing health insurance premiums by up to 40%
item.description: Mexico is projected to have the highest medical cost inflation globally in 2026, with an estimated average rate of 14.8%. According to industry experts, this could lead to three million Mexicans dropping their private health insurance this year.
